title: BMW and Mercedes have some work to do! 😯

author: carwow
description:
Mercedes has unveiled the updated Mercedes-AMG GLE 63 & GLS 63, and we’re about to see what’s changed in terms of design, interior and performance. We’ll also discuss how much we think it will cost. 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-16-06

The AMG GLE 63 & GLS 63 have had mid-life facelifts! 

It's been three years since Mercedes last updated the cars that were originally released in 2018 & 2019 respectively, so let's see what's changed...

In terms of the exterior design, the cars still look relatively similar to the previous editions, with a few tweaks here and there. Up front there’s a bigger & bolder grille (which lights up at night), flanked on either side by headlights featuring massive 3-pointed stars, just like the AMG GT 4-door. The side profile on both cars is almost identical to the previous car, while the taillights feature even more 3-pointed star graphics, and as before, the four massive exhaust pipes have been retained for each
title: You spoke, AMG LISTENED! New GLE & GLS 63 REVEALED!
